# Formalini Public API

Official API docs: https://formalini.com/docs
Base URL: https://api.formalini.com/api/public/v1
Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <FORMALINI_API_KEY>; scopes documents.read, documents.write, workflows.run.
Resources: GET/POST /documents, POST /documents/upload, GET/PATCH /documents/{id}, POST /workflows/dispatch.
Uploads use repeated multipart file fields containing page images, not PDFs.
Quickstart: docs/quickstart.md
Contract notes: docs/api-contract-report.md
OpenAPI: openapi/formalini-public-v1.yaml
Never place a secret key in browser-side or distributed client code.
